# CARCAVELOS DAILY | 20 JUN 2026

**Tiny but clean—perfect for a relaxed dawn patrol or midday cruise.**

**MORNING (03:00–11:00)**
Small 0.8m waves with light northerly winds make pre-dawn your golden window. Swell's steady at 0.6–0.7m, period holding around 6.2–6.4s. Jump in by 07:00 before wind picks up; glassy conditions until around 09:00.

**AFTERNOON EVOLUTION**
Waves tick up slightly to 0.9m by midday, but north wind strengthens considerably—gusting to 18+ km/h by 17:00. Chop builds from 15:00 onward. Water stays warm (27°C peak), but conditions deteriorate through late afternoon.

**AFTERNOON OUTLOOK**
Still surfable until 16:00, but expect texture. Best waves actually mid-afternoon (13:00–15:00) before wind gets too gnarly.

**TIPS**
• Go early or don't go late
• Bring a shortboard—quick paddling wins on small days
• Crowds nonexistent at dawn; take advantage
